user.title: Stundenplan
user.description: Enter your school's access data. The school number and credentials are provided by your school.

klasse_manuell.title: Enter class
klasse_manuell.description: No plan could be found in the next {tage} days (e.g. during holidays), so the class list could not be determined automatically. Please enter the class name exactly as used by your school (e.g. "10a").

faecher.title: Ignore subjects and courses
faecher.description: Select subjects to ignore (e.g. subjects not relevant for your child). If the class has split course groups (e.g. two parallel courses within the same subject), also select the group(s) that don't apply. Both are excluded when determining the first lesson and from the stored day plan - including when a lesson is fully cancelled, as long as the code can be recognized in the hint text.

kalender.title: Holiday calendar (optional)
kalender.description: Optional: select a calendar entity containing school holidays. On days with an event there, no fetch is performed.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The password for Stundenplan24 no longer seems to be correct. Please enter it again.

abort.already_configured: This combination of school number and username is already configured.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Fetches the plan immediately (weekend/holiday checks still apply).

entry_id.name: Config entry ID
entry_id.description: Optional: only refresh a specific configured entry. If empty, all entries are refreshed.
